name: Conrad Punta de Mita
positioning: Beachfront resort on a mile of white sand in the Litibú gated community of Punta de Mita, Riviera Nayarit, with design and a spa inspired by Huichol culture
best_for: Couples wanting a beachfront suite with a private plunge pool
Families wanting a kids' pool and two-bedroom residence suites
Spa lovers interested in Huichol-inspired rituals and a temazcal

facts.text: Conrad Punta de Mita sits where the jungle meets the sea, in the heart of the Riviera Nayarit.
The resort is set on a mile of white-sand beach.
The resort is in the Litibú gated community, among towering palm trees.
The resort's design is subtly inspired by local Huichol culture, with built-in Huichol motifs.
The Ocean View Penthouse Suite has an oversized balcony with a plunge pool and a hammock.
Two-bedroom residence suites are designed for families or entertaining, with a full kitchen and personal concierge services.
With the Compadre Concierge service, a personal Compadre reaches out before arrival to learn guests' preferences.
At the Agave Studio, an agave expert leads tastings from more than 200 bottles of tequila, mezcal, raicilla and sotol.
The main pool area is joined by a central infinity-style pool.
A kid-friendly pool has a waterslide, next to a splash pad pool with water fountains.
Higuera Golf Club, designed by Greg Norman, is just steps from the resort.
Codex, the signature restaurant, serves seasonal specialties such as smoked Pacific oysters, crispy soft-shell crab and steamed lamb barbacoa.

highlights.text: Beachfront Grand Suites have a private plunge pool, an oceanfront balcony and personal concierge services.
Conrad Spa is shaped by the traditions of the Wixárika (Huichol) people.
The temazcal ritual is led by a local shaman, who heats stones on a fire outside the chamber.
Outdoor massage nests place treatment tables in a domed, thatched room for privacy and a connection to nature.
Rooms and suites blend modern design and local culture, with Huichol-inspired art, private terraces and ocean views.

considerations.text: Punta de Mita, where the resort is, is separate from Punta Mita, the peninsula enclave on the opposite, north end of the peninsula.
Puerto Vallarta Airport is about 45 minutes away, and the surf town of Sayulita is about a 20-minute drive.
WhataHotel notes that the remote location requires travel planning for off-property activities.
